# UX & View-State Requirements Checklist: Reset View Button

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements for the "Reset view" control (labelling, placement, accessibility, interaction) and for the starting-view / state-preservation behaviour are complete, clear, consistent and measurable before tasks are generated.
**Created**: 2026-11-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/reset-view.md](../contracts/reset-view.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the coordinates and zoom of the "fixed default view" stated in the spec, or only by reference to "the app's" existing value? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK002 Is the "close zoom level" defined by a value, or only by reference to the zoom the app uses on first centering, and is that reference unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK003 Do the requirements say whether an open popup (e.g. the destination marker popup) should stay open, close, or is out of scope when the view resets? [Gap, Spec §FR-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK004 Do the requirements say where keyboard focus should be after the control is activated? [Gap, Spec §FR-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK005 Do the requirements say whether screen-reader users should get any announcement after a reset, or that no announcement is intended (FR-003 keeps the status message unchanged)? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, §FR-005] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK006 Is the control's position in the keyboard tab order (relative to the search panel and map controls) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Does the spec fix whether the control shows visible text, an icon, or both, or is that choice intentionally left to design? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001] — reviewed by Pilot, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK008 Is "placed so that it does not overlap" backed by a defined position or screen corner and the screen widths to check ("desktop and mobile")? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006] — reviewed by Pilot, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK009 Is a minimum touch-target size specified for the control on touch devices? [Gap, Spec §US2 #3] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK010 Is a visible focus indicator required for the control? [Gap, Spec §FR-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK011 Is a colour-contrast requirement given for the control's label and its boundary against map tiles? [Gap, Non-Functional] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK012 Is "visible whenever the map is shown" clear about states where the map is shown but partly covered (e.g. a long result list in the panel on a short screen)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Does FR-006 (no overlap with the panel and zoom controls) list every on-map element the control could collide with, including the OpenStreetMap attribution? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Plan §research R2] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK014 Are the user-story wording ("starting center", "starting zoom level") and the definition in FR-002 / Clarifications consistent, so "starting view" means the same thing everywhere? [Consistency, Spec §US1, §FR-002] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK015 Is the FR-003 list of unchanged state consistent with every state element the app has (search input and results, destination, routes, selected route, mode, pleasure indicators, position marker, status)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Data model] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK016 Does the edge case "pressed before the first fix → default view; the first fix then becomes the starting view" agree with the app's existing auto-centering on the first fix, i.e. is it stated whether the map should still jump to the user's location when the first fix arrives after a manual reset or pan? [Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-002a] — reviewed by Pilot, 2026-11-10

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK017 Is SC-002 ("within 1 second") clear about where it is measured from and to (press → animation finished and map settled)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK018 Can SC-001 ("100% of attempts") be checked objectively, with a defined set of starting states (panned, zoomed, both, mid-animation)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK019 Does SC-003 ("1 action versus several pan/zoom gestures before") have a baseline that can be measured, or is it descriptive only? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK020 Does SC-004 define "unchanged" for routes and panel content (same routes, same selection, same text) so it can be checked? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK021 Is there a way to tell the "starting view" was reached (e.g. same center within a tolerance, same zoom), given that floating-point centers may not match exactly? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002, §FR-007] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK022 Do the requirements say what happens when routes finish computing *after* a reset (the app frames new routes automatically): is it acceptable for that to move the map away from the starting view? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-003] — reviewed by Pilot, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK023 Is the scenario of location permission granted late (denied at load, allowed later in the same session) covered, and does the "first fix" rule apply to it? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-002a] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK024 Do the requirements say whether pointer gestures on the control (double-click, wheel, drag) must not also act on the map? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK025 Are behaviours on mouse, touch and keyboard all specified with the same outcome (US2 covers keyboard and touch; is mouse plus long-press/hover tooltip on touch addressed)? [Coverage, Spec §US2, §FR-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK026 Is the scenario of a browser window resize or device rotation between load and reset addressed (same center/zoom, or re-fitted)? [Coverage, Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK027 Are the "rapid repeated presses" and "pressed mid-animation" edge cases tied to a measurable end state and a time limit? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §SC-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK028 Is the behaviour defined when map tiles fail to load or the network is offline at reset time (control still available, view still changes)? [Edge Case, Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK029 Is the behaviour defined when the first fix is very inaccurate, or is any first fix accepted as the starting view regardless of accuracy? [Edge Case, Assumption, Spec §FR-002a] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK030 Do the requirements say whether the transition should respect the user's reduced-motion preference, given that animation is allowed? [Gap, Accessibility, Spec §Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK031 Is the English-only label consistent with the rest of the interface and is localization explicitly out of scope? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-10

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK032 Is the plan's assumption about how the map library handles a view change during a running zoom animation recorded as unverified, with a requirement-level fallback if it is wrong? [Assumption, Plan §research R4] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-10
- [x] CHK033 Is the assumption "the starting view is not saved between sessions" stated as a deliberate scope decision rather than an omission? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-10
